# youtrack_project_role_assignment (Resource)

YouTrack project role assignment resource. This resource manages role assignments with ONLY project scope in YouTrack, which assigns a role to a user or group within one project. Attached to a template project, the assignment is inherited by every project created from that template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    youtrack = {
      source = "registry.opentofu.org/elcait/youtrack"
    }
  }
}

provider "youtrack" {
  base_url = "https://youtrack.example.com"
  token    = "your-api-token"
}

# A template project: every project created from it inherits its role assignments
resource "youtrack_project" "template" {
  name         = "Project template"
  short_name   = "TPL"
  leader_login = "admin"
  template     = true
}

resource "youtrack_role" "reporter" {
  name        = "Issue reporter"
  permissions = ["Read Issue", "Create Issue"]
}

# Assign the role to a user within the project only
resource "youtrack_project_role_assignment" "user" {
  role_id      = youtrack_role.reporter.id
  project_id   = youtrack_project.template.id
  holder_login = "john.doe"
  holder_type  = "user" # Optional: 'user' or 'group'
}

# Assign the role to a group within the project only
resource "youtrack_project_role_assignment" "group" {
  role_id      = youtrack_role.reporter.id
  project_id   = youtrack_project.template.id
  holder_login = "my-group" # Group name
  holder_type  = "group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `holder_login` (String) The login (username) of the user or name of the group to assign the role to
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the role is assigned in (e.g. youtrack_project.my_project.id)
- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role to assign (e.g. youtrack_role.my_role.id)

### Optional

- `holder_type` (String) The type of the holder: 'user' or 'group'. If not specified, will try user first, then group.

### Read-Only

- `holder_id` (String) The ID of the holder (computed)
- `holder_name` (String) The name of the holder (computed)
- `id` (String) YouTrack ID of the role assignment (computed)
- `role_name` (String) The name of the assigned role (computed)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import a project role assignment by its ID
terraform import youtrack_project_role_assignment.user "role-assignment-id"
```
